# netcup_user_images (Data Source)

The uploaded images of the netcup SCP user (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_user_images" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `objects` (Attributes List) The images. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Name of the object.
- `last_modified` (String) Time of the last change.
- `size_in_b` (Number) Size in bytes.
- `type` (String) `DISK`, `SNAPSHOT`, `BACKUP` or `MANUAL`.
